about: cc-P164: the play-test page's sessions (Up next). THE OVERSEER'S FILE, like decisions-overlay.json: edit it by hand; nothing writes it. Each session is one sitting: an id (letters, digits, -), a title, a one-line why, a 'before' list (what to do before the first item) and item ids in order, 6 to 12 of Chase's own items (Who You or Bot then you; Bot and CC items are left out whatever this file says). An item belongs to one session: the first that lists it. Open items in no session go into automatic sessions the page builds (by Where, then prompt, newest first, 12 at most). 'stale' is the Probably stale group: ids with a reason; the page adds what its own rules find. 'superseded' maps a prompt to why its items are out of date (its open items go to Probably stale). Seeded 2026-10-18 from D:\UO\overseer\playtest-plan-2026-10-18.md (session 4 there is split in two to keep each under 12). Rules: tools/playsessions.py. ASCII only.
